Name: Haley Quinn
Author: SillyBobThorton
Description:
-DESCRIPTION-

This mod is a replacer for Haley's default character, it basically follows Stardew Valley's deeply entrenched Batman lore by adding Harley Qiunn to the game.  This mod replaces Haley's Portrait and Character sprite.  The only other major change is that Haley Quinn refuses to follow the approved choreography for the flower dance and gets down and dirty instead.  Finally Harley Quinn can follow her passion of being a photographer!  

-DIFFERENT PORTRAIT OPTIONS-

All portrait options come with a running eyeliner version and a clean eyeliner version for those who want them.  I prefer the running eyeliner version.

Option 1 - This portrait captures all of Haley's head while still showing off what the good lord gave her.  (This is my favorite version)

Option 2 - This portrait cuts off directly above the head so that most of the pigtails can still be seen and none of the actual head is cropped out while showing off a bit more of her breasts.

Option 3 - This portrait captures all of Haley's breasts (they take up most of the frame) so that you can see a bit more of her outfit, while sacrificing a large portion of her head.  (who needs to see her face anyway?)

Non-Busty Option - There is a Non-Busty version of both the portrait and the character sprite for those who want a less "enhanced" version of Haley Quinn.

-INSTALLATION-

Portrait-
Extract the Haley.xnb file and put it in your (Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits) folder.  It will ask you to overwrite, click yes.  This will replace Haley's default portrait set with the new busty Harley Quinn one.  Make sure to save a copy of your old Haley.xnb file somewhere to keep as a backup.

Character-
Extract the Haley.xnb file and put it in your (Stardew Valley\Content\Characters) folder.  It will ask you to overwrite, click yes.  This will replace Haley's default character sprite with the new busty Harley Quinn one.  Make sure to save a copy of your old Haley.xnb file somewhere to keep as a backup
